data.one_liner: Typed VModal API client for Flutter to upload videos and search moments by meaning.
data.what_it_does: Provides a typed Dart and Flutter client for the VModal API, enabling semantic video search, streamed signed uploads with progress tracking, and per-operation cancellation. It manages project, collection, and stream scopes for Android and iOS applications.
use_when: Your application needs to upload videos and search them semantically by meaning, speech, text, or imagery using VModal.
You require streamed uploads with live progress updates and cancellation support.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose HTTP client or a REST client not tied to the VModal backend.
Your app targets environments where the VModal API is unavailable.
strengths: Typed API client with request models, responses, and preserved raw JSON.
Supports upload progress tracking via broadcast Dart streams and per-operation cancellation tokens.
Handles scoped project, collection, and stream organization cleanly.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to a proprietary backend service (VModal).
Requires managing API keys and runtime credentials manually in the parent application.
data.setup_notes: Add the package dependency, obtain a VModal API key, and configure your project scopes in code.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making low-level HTTP requests directly instead of using a dedicated typed SDK.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an advanced general-purpose HTTP client with interceptors, global configuration, and custom transformers.
